evidence_items.claim: Barclays hosted DerivHack hackathons (2018, 2019) using ISDA CDM to explore post-trade derivatives processing
evidence_items.excerpt: Barclays hosted DerivHack, a hackathon supported by ISDA that brought teams of coders face to face with the ISDA Common Domain Model. Their task was to bring the CDM to life using new technologies.
evidence_items.caveats: Historical events (2018-2019). Demonstrates CDM thought leadership but not production usage.

evidence_items.claim: Barclays hosted repo hackathon in September 2023 using FINOS CDM with ICMA, ISLA, ISDA, and FINOS
evidence_items.excerpt: Barclays announced a hackathon for market participants to code and showcase solutions that explore novel industry architectures for repo post-trade services. Participants will use FINOS CDM as the industry standard framework.
evidence_items.caveats: Hackathon partnership with FINOS but Barclays is not a FINOS member.

evidence_items.claim: Lee Braine from Barclays CTO office is a leading CDM advocate, calling for infrastructure adoption and estimating $2.5B industry savings
evidence_items.excerpt: Perhaps the biggest champion of CDM as the key to making blockchain a reality in the derivatives space is Barclays. Lee Braine from the CTO office stated the industry could save $2.5 billion a year.
evidence_items.caveats: Advocacy and thought leadership, not production implementation evidence.

evidence_items.claim: Barclays has an internal CDM adoption working group that estimated 25% efficiency gains from CDM in clearing
evidence_items.excerpt: Barclays' working group estimated around 25% gains in efficiency from using CDM only in clearing.
evidence_items.caveats: Paywalled article. Working group confirms internal evaluation but not production adoption.

evidence_items.claim: Barclays named among G-SIBs that have piloted CDM projects for trade and transaction reporting
evidence_items.excerpt: Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Barclays and BNP Paribas have all piloted various projects related to trade and transaction reporting and are examining further use cases.
evidence_items.caveats: Confirms pilot activity but not production usage. Grouped with other G-SIBs.

evidence_items.claim: Barclays won Interest Rate Derivatives House of the Year and Derivatives Client Clearer of the Year at Risk Awards 2024
evidence_items.excerpt: Barclays was named Interest Rate Derivatives House of the Year and Derivatives Client Clearer of the Year, with global client clearing revenues growing 55% since 2018.
evidence_items.caveats: Awards recognize derivatives capability but do not speak to CDM adoption.

evidence_items.claim: Barclays is NOT listed as a FINOS member at any tier (Platinum, Gold, Silver)
evidence_items.excerpt: FINOS members page lists Platinum (Citi, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, UBS, etc.), Gold (Bank of America, Deutsche Bank, Lloyds, NatWest, etc.), Silver members. Barclays is absent.
evidence_items.caveats: Barclays partners with FINOS on hackathons but has not joined as a member.

null_results.implication: Barclays is not a FINOS member despite significant CDM engagement through hackathons. This is an unusual pattern.
No confirmed DRR production usage. Barclays confirmed to have piloted but not confirmed production adoption.
